en: Color-printed vintage postcard showing the apse and rear side of a large Romanesque cathedral. The central octagonal dome-tower with arched windows rises above heavy stone walls, semi-circular apses, and decorative blind arcades. A small entrance porch stands on the left, with a fence and a few pedestrians in front. The lower margin has a printed caption in Italian identifying the location, and the remaining white space is filled with handwritten Italian text and a date.
